methods.name: analyzeCameraSequence
methods.capability: Exact-time segmented observation analysis; supplied typed motion or actual automatic bidirectional LK; translation/similarity/affine/homography; composed global and local image-mesh paths

methods.name: optimizeCameraPath
methods.capability: Nonuniform-time banded velocity/acceleration/jerk objective; smooth or locked segment viewpoint; no image averaging

methods.name: stabilizationMap
methods.capability: Global projective or local mesh inverse; analytic Jacobian/Newton, explicit geometry validity and strength; optional centre magnification preservation, including local mesh target coordinates

methods.name: planAutoCrop
methods.capability: Single or intersected sequence geometry; largest integer-primary-grid aspect-preserving crop, deterministic centre choice, isotropic zoom and explicit maxZoom validity

methods.name: warpStabilized
methods.capability: Qualified source bilinear sampling through typed coordinate map/crop; source F16/F32, working colour, PM/HDR and amount; optional fixed-canvas unscaled crop mask

methods.name: stabilizeSequencePath
methods.capability: Exact composition of the same methods, default shared sequence crop; qualified against manual pipeline hash; explicit fitMaxZoom and actual-observation synthesize framing modes

methods.name: fitStabilizationFraming
methods.capability: Fixed-workspace finite-lattice search for largest sampled admissible strength under maxZoom; explicit diagnostics and resolution

methods.name: synthesizeStabilizedEdges
methods.capability: Actual same-segment timestamped donor images, camera/mesh cross-mapping, PM weighted normalization, edge crop/feather and GPU coverage

countPolicy: Eight real recipe methods; variants are not additional function names. No public SDK/package availability inferred.
limits: Finite strength lattice, not continuous global optimum; preserveScale specifies centre magnification, not all-pixel area preservation
Explicit donor observations only, no automatic upstream sampling or generative content completion
Device/session budgets apply; no arbitrary permanent image ceiling added
Other devices/OS, arbitrary footage, runtime device loss, full official per-control parity and Main public/package/portable integration not established
